name: Annuntia Saturday Open 2022

venue.name: [Annuntia-Scholengroep Wijnegem](http://www.annuntia.be/)
venue.details: Venue entrance is in Kerkhofstraat, so not the school's main entrance in Turnhoutsebaan.

information: This is a twin competition together with [Annuntia Sunday Open 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnnuntiaSundayOpen2022). You can compete in **only one** of the two competitions. See [the registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnnuntiaSaturdayOpen2022#18208-registration) for more info.
